messages:
Sam: FYI: v5.0.1 rollout just started; deploy-bot is seeing elevated streaming stalls in hosted canary (noted by customers). marking here for quick ops decision.

deploy-bot: [ALERT] hosted-canary / stream-encode: tail_latency p99 +640ms, stall_count 72 (threshold 20) -> recommended: auto-revert to v5.0.0.

Nina: I pulled traces, stalls correlate with upstream keepalive changes in ingress-proxy. looks like HTTP/2 windowing tweak.

Carla: Are private and dedicated affected or only hosted? need to avoid broad revert.

Theo: dedicated pools show no regression. problem appears limited to hosted front-door (edge-proxy).

Sam: good note. we have legal/customer change window in ~3h so auto-rollback for everyone is undesirable. propose a scoped rollback for hosted edge only.

Luis: Agreed. Plan: pin ingress proxy image for hosted to tag `edge-stable-202403` and steer hosted traffic to that tag. keep v5.0.1 on other infra.

Rin: who will run the pin and who owns the customer note? I can draft it.

Carla: commands to apply (edge control):
```bash
# set hosted edge image to stable tag
kubectl -n edge set image deploy/ingress ingress=redwood/ingress:edge-stable-202403 --record
# apply traffic allocation to hosted route -> edge-stable-202403 tag
rlctl route update --name=hosted-api --target-tag=edge-stable-202403 --weight=100
```

Theo: I'll execute the kubectl rollout, @Luis take the rlctl step. I'll watch the pods.

Luis: starting rlctl update in 3...2... applying gradual migration (20% -> 60% -> 100%) with 45s intervals and health probes.

deploy-bot: action: rlctl routing change initiated by Luis. step 1: 20% applied. health checks: OK.

Sam: comm checklist: 1) update release_notes to include rollback summary, 2) post short customer status note in /customers/hosted-updates, 3) notify top-account CSMs. keep message minimal.

Rin: draft customer message: "We identified an increase in streaming stalls for the Hosted API after the v5.0.1 rollout. We've reverted the Hosted edge to the previous stable image to restore normal streaming behavior. No action required from you. We're investigating the root cause and will follow up." approve?

Carla: LGTM. Sam approve to post?

Sam: Approved. Theo proceed with kubectl. Luis continue routing steps. keep me in the loop.

Theo: rollout started. 1/3 pods ready -> 2/3 -> 3/3 within 70s.

Luis: routing at 20% -> health OK -> 60% -> OK -> 100% applied. deploy-bot reporting improved latency after second step.

deploy-bot: [INFO] Hosted edge pinned to edge-stable-202403; p99 tail_latency back within 10% of baseline within 120s.

Nina: metrics show stall_count down to 5 over last 5m, p99 delta -15ms. good recovery.

Sam: next actions: (A) update release_notes.md with quick rollback entry and link to incident ticket (OPS-5231), (B) open infra-rollback follow-up: OPS-5232 "Re-evaluate http2 keepalive bump in ingress-proxy", (C) schedule a canary rerun after fix.

Rin: posting customer note now: https://customers.redwood/status/hosted-streaming-2024-03-rollback

Carla: filed OPS-5232 and added @network-team.

Sam: thanks all. marking this thread closed once notes and tickets are in place. :white_check_mark:
